question: is there a gaming club or esports team here
answer:
Yes. The club directory lists these options:
- Ramapo Esports (Athletics): competitive Tri-State competitions and New Jersey leagues. It is open to all students to learn about and offers open events; exclusive player membership is for students who try out for the games provided. Email esports@ramapo.edu. https://archway.ramapo.edu/espo/ [2]
- Ramapo Gamers Club (Student Organization): for casual and competitive players; meetings share esports-event information and include a small tournament or game. Email gamers@ramapo.edu. https://archway.ramapo.edu/RCES/ [3]
- Geek and Nerd Culture (Student Organization): games, anime, tabletop RPGs, Minecraft servers, and board game nights. https://archway.ramapo.edu/GNCulture/ [1][7]
- Ramapo Girls in Gaming (Student Organization): gaming activities and events for female-presenting people and allies. Email rgg@ramapo.edu. https://archway.ramapo.edu/gaming/ [4][5]
- Rhythm Game Club (Student Organization): weekly rhythm-game setups and activities; no prior experience is required and players of all backgrounds are welcome. Email rrgc@ramapo.edu. https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/rhythm-game-club/ [11][12]
- Ramapo Smash Club (Student Organization): meetings and events for people interested in Super Smash Bros. Email smashclub@ramapo.edu. https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/ramapo-smash-club/ [6][16]
All clubs listed on the college clubs page are open to all students. [9] For esports information, the page points to Intramural & Club Sports Info: https://ramapoathletics.com/sports/2018/9/26/intramurals-and-competitive-sports-clubs.aspx [13]
